defects.title: Date Invariant Ambiguity Conservative Abstention on Identical Slash Strings
defects.description: When comparing two identical ambiguous slash date strings (e.g. '05/06/2024' vs '05/06/2024'), compare_dates returns MatchGrade.AMBIGUOUS / Status.REVIEW. While string identity is exact, semantic calendar identity is ambiguous because different issuing authorities may follow differing regional date conventions (DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY).
defects.remediation: Preserve current conservative abstention policy. Do not relax into false certainty without authority locale metadata.

defects.title: Hardcoded Procedural Citations vs Declarative Source Manifest Registry
defects.description: The procedural validator embeds statutory citation strings directly in code rather than resolving them dynamically from packs/generic.demo/sources.yaml.
defects.remediation: Long-term migration to pure declarative SchemePack primitives; retain backwards compatibility in MVP validator.

defects.title: Odisha Post-Matric Specific Rules Hardcoded as Global Defaults in SchemeConfig
defects.description: SchemeConfig defaults target_state to 'ODISHA' and scheme name to 'Odisha Post-Matric Scholarship', tightly coupling the default procedural engine to a single Indian state jurisdiction.
defects.remediation: Config parameter injection and declarative scheme pack loading decouple jurisdiction cleanly.

defects.title: Income Tolerance Match Grade Divergence Between V1 and V2 Truth Tables
defects.description: When declared and certified income vary within positive non-zero tolerance, compare_amounts produces status 'REVIEW' with MatchGrade.COMPATIBLE under V2 truth table, whereas legacy validator emitted PASS with informational note.
defects.remediation: V2 conservative truth table is authoritative: variation within tolerance requires human review rather than silent unconditional clearance.
defects.status: Standardized to V2 Conservative Truth Table
